param_docs.mullion_ext_top: Mullion extension above the head centre-line (mm). source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.mullion_ext_bottom: Mullion extension below the sill centre-line (mm). source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.transom_clearance: Clearance per transom end between transom and mullion face (mm). source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.glass_deduction_x: Axis width minus this deduction = glass/fill width (mm); encodes face width and glass bite. source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.glass_deduction_y: Axis height minus this deduction = glass/fill height (mm). source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.gasket_runs_per_field_edge: Number of gasket runs along each field edge (e.g. inner + outer). source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.connectors_per_transom: Transom connectors per transom member (one per end). source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.brackets_per_anchor: Brackets per mullion per anchor level. source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.max_bar_length: Maximum single-bar member length (mm) before a splice is required. source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.min_field_width: Minimum field axis width (mm). source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.min_field_height: Minimum field axis height (mm). source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.max_field_width: Maximum field axis width (mm). source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.max_field_height: Maximum field axis height (mm). source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.end_caps_per_mullion: End caps per mullion line. source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.splice_sleeves_per_splice: Splice sleeves per required splice (count only; positions not computed). source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.sealant_runs_per_perimeter: Perimeter sealant runs around the framework outline. source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.max_glass_weight_kg: Design check: maximum weight of a single glass/spandrel pane (kg) = pane area x glass_type.weight_kg_m2; above it a GLASS_WEIGHT_HIGH warning is raised. source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.max_field_area_m2: Design check: maximum field axis area (m²); above it a FIELD_AREA_HIGH warning is raised. source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.max_field_aspect_ratio: Design check: maximum field axis aspect ratio (long side / short side); above it a FIELD_ASPECT_HIGH warning is raised. source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.max_unsupported_mullion_span: Design check: maximum vertical mullion span (mm) between anchor levels or from an anchor to the framework bottom/head; above it a MULLION_SPAN_HIGH warning is raised. Not a structural check. source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
param_docs.min_anchor_levels: Design check: minimum number of anchor levels per elevation; fewer raises an ANCHORS_MISSING warning. source: DEMO placeholder — requires approval
